visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands with light pink manicured nails holds an ornate, oval-shaped gold photo frame against a white background. Inside the frame is a photograph of a smiling woman, a toddler, and a man in front of a red vehicle. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a person using small scissors to cut a sheet of red textured paper into small triangular shapes. (3) The person applies white paper strips and small white dots to the red triangles, creating miniature Santa hats using glue. (4) The miniature hats are then glued onto the heads of the individuals pictured in the gold frame. (5) A woman with long blonde hair, wearing a white button-down cardigan and a black skirt, kneels in front of a Christmas tree adorned with red and gold ornaments to hang the frame. (6) She holds a large roll of wide red velvet ribbon with gold glitter dots and uses a pink stapler to attach it vertically and horizontally across a dark wood-grain door. (7) She ties a large, floppy bow at the intersection of the ribbons near the door handle. (8) The woman opens a large cardboard box and draws house shapes with a black marker. (9) She uses white, red, and yellow markers to decorate the cardboard cutouts as gingerbread houses, adding white 3D glue to simulate icing. (10) The woman assembles the houses and pink velvet bows onto a thin white ribbon to create a garland. (11) She stands in a bedroom and displays the finished garland before hanging it on the wall above a white headboard with warm under-cabinet lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, syncopated jazz-pop piano music begins with a bright tempo. (2) A sharp 'snip-snip' sound of scissors cutting paper is audible, perfectly synced with visual transitions. (3) Light, percussive tapping and paper rustling occur as objects are moved. (4) A mechanical 'click-clack' stapler sound is heard repeatedly as ribbon is attached. (5) Short, stylized 'squeak' and friction sounds coincide with drawing on cardboard. (6) A wet 'squish' or 'pop' sound effect is heard when glue is applied. (7) The BGM continues throughout with a steady drum beat. (8) At the conclusion, a brief female 'Woo!' cheer with high vocal arousal and positive valence sounds as the final project is shown.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Decoration Item 1 -> Decoration Item 2 -> Decoration Item 3 -> Final Result
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a festive lifestyle tutorial showcasing creative and affordable Christmas DIY decorations for a modern apartment. It aims to inspire viewers by showing how simple materials like paper, ribbon, and cardboard can be transformed into personalized holiday decor, emphasized by the 'POV' framing of celebrating Christmas in Taipei.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: No specific brand names or calls to purchase are highlighted; focuses on DIY creation.
